summary: A failed worker attempt at a human_checkpoint step has a declared recovery: the engine admits record_worker_failure there as a hold-mode recovery that changes no definition, and the recorded failure dispositions the attempt, so the operator's own gate opens, and the record then admits the CD-0143 D1 corrective return at the checkpoint. The checkpoint hold keys on attempts a worker actually dispatched, not on unused windows.
title: CD-0187 D2 and D3 release the checkpoint gate at the recorded failure, and an unused dispatch window holds
